76ers 111Heat 104

LeBron’s triple-double and Maxey’s 30 sink Miami

Final · Wed, Nov 25 · Philadelphia

Philadelphia beat Miami 111–104, a 7-point home win. The 76ers move to 15–4; the Heat fall to 10–7.
